answer: Each identity claims one ferrous-stamped shale lease, prices it at 100 and pays 5 Harberger tax each epoch. A gale audit buys any underpriced lease at its stated price: underpricing loses the plot, overpricing bleeds tax. The k-th lease costs 5+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,002,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented lease fails: its owner sets the price; a buyout burns both bonds. An honest agent prices once, pays 5, keeps its lease.
